title: Online Enrollment Terms for the Residential Gas Sign-Up Credit
content:
**Term.** On a Residential Natural Gas Supply sign-up credit, the online-adjusted plan amount depends on how the agreement was enrolled: when it was enrolled through the web channel and supply started no more than 30 calendar days after the enrollment date, the plan amount is multiplied by 1.25; when it was enrolled through the web channel and supply started more than 30 calendar days after the enrollment date, 5.00 is added to the plan amount; any other enrollment — by phone or by mail — keeps the plan amount unchanged. The online-adjusted plan amount takes the place of the plan amount in the sign-up credit owed.

The records read are the enrollment channel, the enrollment date and the service start date on the agreement. The plan amount is the plan's one-time sign-up bill credit.

| Enrollment channel | Calendar days from the enrollment date to the service start date | Online-adjusted plan amount |
|---|---|---|
| web | 30 or fewer | plan amount multiplied by 1.25 |
| web | more than 30 | plan amount plus 5.00 |
| phone or mail | any | plan amount unchanged |

### Worked cases (hypothetical plan amount 40.00)

| Channel | Days to supply start | Online-adjusted plan amount |
|---|---|---|
| web | 30 | 40.00 multiplied by 1.25 is 50.00 |
| web | 31 | 40.00 plus 5.00 is 45.00 |
| phone | 12 | 40.00 |
| mail | 50 | 40.00 |
